title: Tech Lead | Engenheiro De Ia
description:
#VemPraTrinks


A Trinks é uma plataforma SaaS líder em gestão e agendamento para salões de beleza, barbearias, clínicas estéticas e estabelecimentos de bem-estar em todo o Brasil. Estamos construindo uma nova frente de produto baseada em inteligência artificial generativa , com foco em automação de atendimento e gestão do ERP.


Buscamos um profissional com perfil técnico sênior, com vivência em IA generativa e engenharia de software, para liderar o desenvolvimento de um novo produto baseado em modelos de linguagem (LLMs) , integrando inteligência artificial ao core de serviços da Trinks.


Dá uma olhada no seu papel nessa #revolução:


  • Liderar e desenvolver a criação de um sistema conversacional com IA generativa (LLM);
  • Projetar arquitetura escalável e segura com integração aos sistemas da Trinks;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, UX, Dados e Engenharia;
  • Implementar soluções baseadas em RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) com foco em contexto e precisão;
  • Definir boas práticas de desenvolvimento, versionamento, testes e deploy de soluções com IA;
  • Acompanhar performance, custo e segurança dos modelos em produção.


O que você precisa para o #match perfeito:


  • Experiência consolidada em engenharia de software;
  • Experiência prática com LLMs (OpenAI, Claude, Mistral, etc.);
  • Domínio de Python (e desejável experiência com C#/.NET);
  • Conhecimento emLangChain, LlamaIndex, ou similares;
  • Conhecimento dearquitetura em nuvem (preferencialmente AWS);
  • Familiaridade com sistemas assíncronos/event-driven (Kafka, SQS, etc.).


Será um diferencial se você conhecer:


  • Ter liderado ou desenvolvido projetos com IA generativa e agentes conversacionais.
  • Conhecimento em prompt engineering, embeddings, vetores e fine-tuning leve.
  • Experiência com mecanismos de controle de alucinação e segurança em LLMs.


Saca só o que OFERECEMOS:


100% Home office;

⏳ Contratação CLT(40 horas semanais);

Auxílio home office;

Vale alimentação e vale refeição no cartão flexível;

Plano de Saúde SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

Plano Odonto SulAmérica (custo zero para o colaborador);

title: Technical Leader - Consultor(A) Sênior ( Microsoft Power Plataform)
description:

E sempre mantemos nosso lema de: essência, experiência e excelência.

title: Qa & Ra Specialist
description:
Work place: Sao Paulo, Brazil

QA & RA Specialist (100 % workload)


About Selectchemie AG

Selectchemie is an independent Swiss company serving the pharmaceutical and nutrition industry since 1969 as a premier supplier of high quality ingredients and generic finished dosage forms. As a full service provider we create added value by offering comprehensive technical, scientific, regulatory and commercial support all along the value chain. Worldwide, our 120 experienced professionals with commercial and scientific background, based at the headquarters in Zurich, Switzerland and locations in 18 countries, provide customers, principals and suppliers with solutions tailored to their needs.


Join our Pharma LATAM team

We offer a broad product portfolio of APIs & excipients and are an established hub for customers sourcing high-quality bulk raw material as well as for renowned manufacturers who benefit from our broad customer base in various markets. We are continuously expanding our global network as well as our services. We are seeking a QA & RA Associate to support our Pharma LATAM sales team in achieving their regulatory and quality assurance objectives, with focus on Brazilian and Mexican markets. This role involves close collaboration with internal teams, suppliers, and customers to ensure compliance with ANVISA and other relevant regulations. The ideal candidate will have a strong regulatory mindset, attention to detail, and excellent communication skills.


Your tasks and responsibilities


ANVISA Submissions & API/Excipients Registration

  • Prepare, submit, and manage ANVISA dossiers from our partners and of our ownership for API and excipient registrations, renewals, variations, and amendments, in accordance with RDC 359/2022 and RDC 361/2022, which require registration of APIs used in distribution and manufacturing in Brazil.
  • Ensure compliance with ANVISA regulatory guidelines, monitor updates to regulatory frameworks, and implement required modifications proactively.
  • Be designated as an authorized user in order to act on behalf of the suppliers for CADIFA application.


Life Cycle Management (LCM)

  • Carry out lifecycle maintenance activities, including annual renewals, post-approval changes, and variations for APIs registrations – CADIFA under established procedures
  • Conduct gap analysis for regulatory documents and gather necessary supporting documentation from suppliers and internal stakeholders.


Regulatory Intelligence & Compliance

  • Monitor evolving Brazilian regulatory requirements and advise stakeholders accordingly.
  • Support internal teams—such as Quality, Supply Chain, Legal, and Commercial—by providing up-to-date regulatory guidance for API/excipient registration, import, storage, and distribution compliance.


Client & Stakeholder Support

  • Provide regulatory support and guidance to internal clients (e.G., sales, procurement) and external clients (e.G., manufacturers or exporters of APIs/excipients) regarding registration strategy, timelines, and documentation requirements.
  • Assist during ANVISA inspections, inquiries, or audits, and support resolution of any regulatory issues by preparing requested documentation and supporting senior colleagues.


Documentation & Submission Management

  • Assemble submission packages with precision—compiling documentation, certificates (e.G., GMP, certificates of analysis), product specifications, technical data, and translations where necessary.
  • Maintain regulatory dossier documentation in tracked systems to ensure completeness and ease of retrieval.


Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Coordinate with commercial, quality assurance, procurement, and legal teams to align on regulatory deliverables and prioritize registration activities.
  • Share documentation with regional/global RA teams for alignment.


Process Enhancement & SOP Development

  • Follow existing SOPs related to APIs/excipients registration, dossier submission, product renewal, and regulatory intelligence and provide feedback on potential improvements
  • Identify process inefficiencies and propose improvements to optimize submission workflows and compliance robustness.


Training & Regulatory Advocacy

  • Educate relevant internal teams (e.G. sales, imports) on regulatory implications—for example, registration deadlines, documentation requirements, handling of restricted substances—to ensure regulatory awareness throughout the organization.
  • When relevant, participate in trade associations or regulatory working groups to stay informed and potentially influence ANVISA’s regulatory environment.


Your profile

  • Education: Degree in Pharmacy, Chemistry, Life Sciences, or a related technical field.
  • Experience: 3-5 years of previous experience in Regulatory Affairs and Quality Assurance, preferably in the pharmaceutical sector.
  • Knowledge: Understanding of ANVISA regulations, GMP, and regulatory processes.
  • Skills: Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Communication: Ability to effectively interact with internal teams, customers, and suppliers.
  • Languages: Proficiency in English and Portuguese;
    Spanish is a plus.


What’s in for you?

  • Entrepreneurial position in a dynamic globally acting team
  • Your input is key and you’re part of creating our future success
  • Close cooperation with colleagues across the entire hierarchy within Selectchemie
  • Short decision processes
  • Attractive compensation package and hybrid working

title: Desenvolvimento De Negócios Globais - Especialistas Em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.

title: Ngs Technical Sales Specialist | Genomics & Life Sciences (Brazil)
description:
About the Opportunity


Are you a scientist at heart, passionate about genomics and the power of technology to transform healthcare?

At MGI , we combine scientific excellence with innovation to redefine what’s possible in genetic sequencing and automation.

We’re seeking a NGS Technical Sales Specialist who blends a strong scientific foundation with a consultative commercial mindset — someone who can speak the language of researchers, understand their challenges, and guide them toward solutions that accelerate discovery.

Drive Scientific Engagement & Growth

  • Provide consultative pre- and post-sales support to ensure customers achieve optimal experimental outcomes.
  • Collaborate with Field Application Scientists to deliver a seamless scientific and technical experience.
  • Conduct presentations, workshops, and seminars to demonstrate the impact of MGI technologies on research and clinical applications.


Market Intelligence & Collaboration

  • Stay ahead of market trends in genomics, molecular biology, and precision medicine to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Represent MGI at scientific conferences, trade shows, and regional events as a trusted partner in the life sciences community.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Management, Marketing, and R&D to align customer feedback with product innovation.


Reporting & Planning

  • Maintain accurate forecasts, pipeline data, and customer records using CRM tools (Salesforce).
  • Monitor performance metrics and adjust strategies to meet and exceed objectives.


Who You Are

  • A scientist with commercial curiosity — passionate about both research and relationship building.
  • Strong communicator who can translate complex scientific concepts into clear, compelling discussions.
  • Self-motivated, organized, and adaptable in a fast-paced environment.
  • Driven by the opportunity to make genomics more accessible and impactful for all.


What You Bring

Scientific Expertise

  • Solid understanding of genomics, molecular biology, or biotechnology .
  • Hands-on experience with NGS workflows, DNA/RNA sequencing, or lab automation .


Commercial Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in life science sales, business development, or field-based scientific roles .
  • Proven record of achieving or exceeding sales goals through consultative, science-driven engagement.


Education & Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or a related field required;
    Master’s or Ph.D. preferred .
  • English: Advanced | Spanish: Intermediate to Advanced.
  • Proficiency with Salesforce and Microsoft Office Suite .
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% across Brazil.


What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation and performance-based incentives.
  • Comprehensive health and dental insurance .
  • Meal stipend and fitness allowance to support wellbeing.


About MGI

MGI is a global leader in genomics innovation, delivering advanced sequencing and automation solutions that empower scientists and healthcare professionals worldwide.

Our mission is to make high-quality, affordable genomics accessible to all — enabling discoveries that improve lives and transform the future of medicine.

Join us and help shape the next generation of genomics.

title: Senior Software Quality Analyst
description:
Join one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world! Here you can transform your career!

Why join TCS? Here at TCS we believe that people make the difference, that's why we live a culture of unlimited learning full of opportunities for improvement and mutual development. The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.


We are looking for a Senior Software Quality Analyst , who wants to learn and transform their career, in a CLT contract, hybrid, in the city of São Paulo.


In this role you will:

  1. Test Planning and Design:

- Develop comprehensive test plans and test cases based on functional and non-functional requirements.

- Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand project requirements and acceptance criteria.

2. Test Execution:

- Execute manual and automated tests to identify software defects and ensure that applications meet quality standards.

- Perform various types of testing, including functional, regression, integration, performance, and usability testing.

3. Defect Management:

- Identify, document, and track software defects using bug tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or Azure Devops.

- Work closely with the development team to reproduce, diagnose, and resolve defects.

4. Automation Testing:

- Develop and maintain automated test scripts using tools such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, or similar frameworks.

- Integrate automated tests into the CI/CD pipeline to ensure continuous testing and rapid feedback.

5. Test Environment Management:

- Set up and maintain test environments, including test data and configurations.

- Ensure that test environments are representative of production environments to accurately assess application performance and behavior.

6. Reporting and Documentation:

- Prepare and present test reports, including test coverage, test results, and defect metrics.

- Document test procedures, test cases, and test results for future reference and audit purposes.

7. Continuous Improvement:

- Participate in retrospectives and continuous improvement initiatives to enhance testing processes and methodologies.

- Stay current with industry trends and best practices in software testing and quality assurance.

Qualifications:

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.

- 5+ years of experience in software testing and quality assurance.

- Strong understanding of software development life cycle (SDLC) and testing methodologies.

- Experience with test automation tools and frameworks such as Selenium, TestNG, JUnit, or similar.

- Proficiency in using bug tracking and test management tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or Trello.

- Knowledge of programming languages such as Java, Python, or JavaScript is a plus.

- Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.

- Strong attention to detail and a commitment to delivering high-quality software.

- Effective communication and collaboration skills.

- Speak professional Spanish. Professional English is preferred.


Good to Have:

Knowledge of the insurance market.

Have good communication, organization, engagement, and resilience.

title: Electrical Commissioning Engineer
description:
Datacenter People is a specialized recruitment company working with the leading data center commissioning and quality services firms in the world.

title: Executive Administrative Assistant
description:
About the Role


This is not a typical virtual assistant position. We're looking for an AI-forward Executive Assistant with a Chief-of-Staff potential in the future who builds systems, owns outcomes, and drives the week to zero open tabs and inbox zero.

You'll work directly with Billie Graham , a strategic leader managing multiple high-growth ventures across commercial construction, lead generation, nonprofit leadership, property management, and family. Billie is based in Charlotte, NC, and needs someone who can anticipate needs, convert ambiguity into calendar blocks and checklists, and relentlessly close loops.

The Goal: Expand capacity and increase velocity of execution through systems, AI automation, and proactive operational support.

This role offers rare exposure to diverse industries while building the foundational processes that will enable rapid scaling. You'll be part of the early team, collaboratively identifying tools and systems needed to achieve great outcomes.

About Billie's Ventures


All ventures are in growth mode, and most do not have formal processes yet. You'll solve for and document processes to allow rapid onboarding of future hires with repeatable results.

  • Myers & Chapman – Strategic Markets Leader for Healthcare and Public Projects at this Commercial General Contractor
  • Leads Exchange Group – Industry networking agency launching a new high-ticket service offering in 2025
  • ReGroup Carolinas – Board Member for this nonprofit focused on workforce development in construction trades
  • Rental Property – Management of two rental units


Who We're Looking For


We need a systems-thinker with high agency who is AI-native, proactive, and relentlessly follows through. You should be comfortable with ambiguity, able to convert loose ideas into structured action plans, and driven to improve workflows weekly.

Critical mindset: We're looking for critical thinking over "task-taker." You should anticipate needs, propose solutions, and own outcomes—not just execute orders.

Personality Traits of Successful Candidates:
  • Proactive and calm under pressure
  • Highly organized and goal-oriented
  • Systems-first thinker with high agency
  • Pushes for clarity and closes loops consistently
  • Low-ego, coachable, rigorous about details and data
  • Comfortable saying "no/next" to protect priorities
Operational Cadence & Responsibilities
Weekly Rhythm:

Calendar & Commitments:

  • Own and manage family/school/kids' activities, professional meetings, travel, and reservations
  • Send Friday Weekly Brief : next week at a glance, risks flagged, top 3 priorities identified

Inbox & Communications:

  • Triage emails and meeting invites daily
  • File receipts and manage reimbursements
  • Maintain stakeholder communication loops

Task System:

  • Maintain running capture board across all ventures
  • Convert texts/voice notes → tasks with deadlines
  • Confirm task owner and status;
    nudge until done

Research & Automation:

  • Conduct project research and generate executive summaries
  • Web scraping and competitive tracking
  • Automate report generation and research tasks
  • Contact enrichment and CRM logging
  • Public records, permits, budgets research

SOP Engine:

  • Record Looms of recurring tasks
  • Ship 1+ SOP per week to the vault
  • Document processes to enable future team scaling
  • Iterate and refine edge cases

Family/Personal Operations:

  • Manage school communications and kids' calendars
  • Coordinate family travel and summer camp planning
  • Handle household-related administrative tasks

AI & Systems Improvement:

  • Propose workflow automation improvements weekly
  • Implement AI tools to increase efficiency
  • Build and optimize capture → triage → plan → execute systems
  • Raise quality bars continuously
Required Skills & Experience
Must-Have:


  • 1–2 years minimum executive assistant or operations experience
  • Advanced AI literacy : Fluent with ChatGPT, Copilot, and Perplexity;
    strong prompt crafting abilities
  • Calendar triage & stakeholder management : Expert-level scheduling and communication coordination
  • Research skills : Public records, permits, budgets, market intelligence
  • SOP creation : Ability to document processes via Loom-to-SOP workflow
  • Excel/Power BI basics : Structured data work and simple reporting
  • Clear written English : Concise, action-oriented communication style
  • Security hygiene : Understanding of role-based access and data protection
  • Documentation discipline : Rigorous attention to detail
  • Strong interest in AI use cases and implementation
Nice-to-Have:


  • Basic Python or no-code automation experience (Zapier, Make, n8n)
  • AEC (Architecture/Engineering/Construction) familiarity: Procore, RFQ/RFP exposure
  • Web scraping capabilities
  • HubSpot or CRM management experience
  • Contact enrichment skills (LinkedIn, research tools)
  • Power BI visualization and dashboard creation
  • Golf handicap lookup experience (when relevant for relationship building)
Tools & Platforms You'll Use


  • Email/SMS (Google & Microsoft suites)
  • Ninety.Io (project/goal management)
  • ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity (AI tools – critical)
  • Slack, Discord, Telegram (team communication)
  • SharePoint, Google Workspace, MS Teams (document management)
  • Excel (data organization)
  • Additional tools to be collaboratively identified
What We Offer


  • Compensation: Starting at $1,100 USD per month
  • Full-time position: 40 hours per week
  • Consistent schedule: 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST, Monday–Friday
  • Fully remote: Work from anywhere
  • Direct collaboration with an entrepreneurial leader
  • Exposure to multiple industries: Construction, lead generation, nonprofit, real estate
  • Ground-floor opportunity: Help build foundational systems for scaling ventures
  • Learning environment: Strong focus on AI implementation and automation
Company Culture & Values


Culture in one line: We are problem solvers—systems over heroics—and the whole is greater than the sum of its parts.


Core Values:

  • Integrity
  • Growth Minded
  • In Service to Others
  • Provide Solutions
Onboarding & Support


There is currently no formal onboarding program—this will be part of the early partnership. You'll collaboratively identify the tools and support structures needed to achieve great outcomes. This is an opportunity to help shape the operational foundation from the ground up.


Application Process


Please send the following to (operations+ ) :

  1. Resume: As a PDF titled (Lastname.Firstname.ExecutiveAssistant.Pdf)
  2. Cover Letter addressing:
  • How you meet the required skills and experience
  • Specific examples of systems or SOPs you've built
  • Your experience with AI tools (ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, automation tools)
  • A time you anticipated a leader's needs and proactively solved a problem
  • How you've closed loops and driven projects to completion
  • Why you're interested in supporting multiple ventures simultaneously
  1. AI Competency Example: Share a specific example of how you've used AI tools to automate a workflow, solve a problem, or improve efficiency
  2. Email Subject: Systems Over Heroics

Timeline: We aim to fill this position within 2–3 weeks.

Well-structured and thoughtful applications demonstrating critical thinking and systems-first approach will stand out. If you have questions about the role, feel free to include them in your message.

description:

A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.

title: Application Engineer
description:

The Application Engineer is responsible for providing technical support to customers, who provide installation, configuration, and programming of ESTUN robots. This includes collaborating with the sales team to define/select the correct product, preparing simulations, and ensuring the successful deployment of systems.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Provide feedback and suggest improvements to the development team to enhance product quality and functionality.

title: Merchant Onboarding Analyst (Shift Position)
description:
About us

Keeta, the international subsidiary of Meituan—the global delivery giant—is on a mission to revolutionize food and consumer product delivery worldwide. With our core belief: "We help people eat better, live better," we're taking innovation to the global stage! Within just one year, Keeta has become an industry leader in Hong Kong. With our ongoing expansions into Saudi Arabia, Keeta achieved the remarkable feat of launching 5 cities in just 17 days, allowing the Arabic world to witness the speed of China! Keeta offers exciting opportunities to join a transformative journey that is shaping the future of delivery and retail. Join Keeta, explore the world.

Know more: Keeta website.


What you'll Do :

1. Review documents and information provided by merchants to ensure accuracy before the store goes live.

2. Upload and verify merchant account details, ensuring all information is complete, correct, and efficiently processed.

3. Check merchant qualifications according to company rules.

4. Review other applications submitted by business colleagues or merchants.

5. Organize and manage store photo-taking services.

6. Work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including night shifts and weekends.

7. Collaborate with Operations, Product, and other relevant teams to support merchant onboarding and resolve related issues.


What we need from You :

1. Responsible and reliable, willing to work hard to achieve team goals.

2. Eager to learn, open to new things, and able to adapt to changes.

3. Good communication skills, a team player, and willing to grow together with others.

4. Portuguese speaker, fluent in both spoken and written Portuguese. sales support is a plus (training will be provided).

5. Willing and able to work according to a shift schedule (5x2), including shift weekends. 6. Able to work efficiently under pressure, especially during peak periods, and handle handovers and transitions between teams smoothly.

7. Strong sense of responsibility and attention to detail in managing shift tasks and onboarding processes.


What makes this role excinting :

1.Take part in the rapid growth of Meituan's global delivery business, work with an international team, and enjoy plenty of opportunities to learn and grow.

2.Friendly and supportive team environment, where helps each other and grows together. Fun and relaxed atmosphere with everyone clear career development paths.


Why Join Keeta

Keeta is redefining the future of food delivery with a clear vision and innovative spirit. As a fast-scaling brand under Meituan's global ambition, we offer a unique blend of stability and startup energy, providing boundless opportunities for personal and professional growth. Whether you want to specialize in your field or gain cross-functional experience, Keeta empowers you to take charge of your career.

As we expand globally, we are committed to building a workplace that reflects our unique culture while incorporating global best practices. You'll be part of a company that's transforming the delivery industry while supporting local communities, empowering merchants, and delivering outstanding customer experiences.

At Keeta, you'll collaborate with a passionate and pragmatic global team across over 94 countries, bringing diverse perspectives that drive creativity and innovation. We believe diversity is our strength and it pushes us to deliver better solutions for our customers and partners in Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, and beyond.

Keeta offers limitless career growth and equal development opportunities, empowering you to grow as the company grows. Every day presents an opportunity for you to make a meaningful impact, grow professionally, and be part of something extraordinary. You'll thrive in a dynamic environment where every contribution is valued. Together, let's build the future of food delivery.

title: Business Analyst | Ops

Somos o G4 Educação, somos A Evolução da Escola de Negócios.

Estamos em busca de pessoas para atuarem no time de Business OPS do G4 Educação, onde sua principal missão será executar projetos estratégicos num “squad de consultoria interna”. Como Analista de OPS, seu papel será atuar em uma squad de três pessoas compostas por um Business Architect, você e outro analista de OPS para executar projetos críticos para o G4, de diferentes áreas.

Sua atuação será baseada em projetos que podem ser orientados a otimização do processos e rotinas de outras áreas ou unidades de negócio, ou então focados em desenvolver MVPs de novas soluções e produtos, exigindo assim um perfil hands on, analítico, orientado a execução e entrega de resultados de maneira independente.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Após ser contratado(a) para essa posição, o esperado é que você execute os projetos com 1. qualidade e 2. agilidade. Como os projetos variam de acordo com a área e tempo, seu dia-a-dia será dinâmico, onde um mês pode ser completamente diferente do outro. Com isso em mente, vale deixarmos claro o que esperamos de você na 1ª semana, dado que ela ditará as próximas:

  • Avaliar o Backlog de Problemas do G4 e garantir que ele está atualizado com uma lista exaustiva que representa as principais dores das pessoas em posições estratégicas no G4, e caso não, atuar para que esteja atualizado;
  • Mergulhar nas ferramentas internas (Notion, Miro, Hubspot, Data Studio), metodologias e boas práticas de gestão de projetos;
  • Atuar, junto com um Business Architect, para priorizar projetos;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração do planejamento do projeto e partir imediatamente para a execução;


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Essa vaga tem como perfil ideal um profissional analítico, 100% data driven, que tenha trabalho com dados, automações (no code), programação (low code) ou gestão de projetos/produtos;
  • Do ponto de vista prático, precisa ser uma pessoa com perfil orientado a execução, e com boas capacidades analíticas e de execução, além de conhecimento de processos, e idealmente, com algum grau de familiaridade com métodos ágeis, e frameworks de growth.
  • Por fim, é necessário que você tenha bastante afinidade com dados, além de conhecer e ter a capacidade de usar algumas dessas ferramentas e sistemas: Excel, Google Sheets, Google Analytics, SQL, Python, Google GTM, Power BI, DataStudio, Zapier (Ou similares), Notion, Figma (ou similares).

title: Presales Manager
description:

title: Especialista Em Engenharia De Qualidade De Software

  1. Planejar e executar estratégias de testes funcionais e não funcionais , alinhadas às necessidades de negócio e diretrizes do COE;

title: Trust Accountant Support Trainer
description:
Trust Accountant Support Trainer


Location: Brazil, fully remote

Type: Full-time, 8hours/day

Availability: ASAP to 2 weeks

Rate: 5,000 BRL to 14,000 BRL per month

Level: Junior to Senior

Setup: PJ/Consultancy

Industry: Hospitality/Accommodation/Rental

Experience:

  • Accounting or Bookkeeping (Required)
  • Onboarding Clients to understand Accounting

Equipment: Needs to have own machine, equipment not provided



Job Description

Do you have a strong accounting background but want more variety than balance sheets and reports? Do you enjoy teaching others, solving problems, and helping people succeed? If so, this role might be the perfect fit.

As a Software Accounting Trainer / Onboarding Specialist, you’ll play a key role in guiding new clients in the vacation rental industry through their onboarding process. You’ll ensure proper setup of taxes, fees, and trust accounting, and train clients on how to use the software system effectively to stay compliant and confident. This role blends accounting expertise with training, customer service, and problem-solving in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead onboarding and transition sessions for new vacation rental clients, ensuring accurate accounting system setup.
  • Train clients via Zoom on all accounting functions within the system, including trust accounting.
  • Perform and review accounting tasks such as:
  • Bank and non-bank account reconciliations
  • Entering transactions and journal entries
  • Preparing Trial Balance and Trust reports
  • Reviewing client entries for errors and developing correction plans
  • Identify misplaced or invalid data, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely resolution.
  • Respond to support tickets and client calls promptly, providing clear, professional guidance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through exceptional customer service.
  • Write and update knowledge base articles to support client and internal education.
  • Lead webinars and group training sessions for clients and staff on accounting best practices.
  • Document and analyze client questions and escalate issues when necessary.
  • Collaborate with instructional design and internal teams to create and improve training resources.
  • Participate in team meetings and internal projects, contributing to process improvements and knowledge sharing.


Qualifications & Requirements

  • 2–5 years of accounting or bookkeeping experience, preferably in property management or vacation rental industries.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting or equivalent professional experience.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles;
    trust accounting knowledge highly preferred.
  • Experience with accounting for vacation rentals, property management, or hospitality a strong plus.
  • Proficiency with Excel, Word, and video conferencing tools (Zoom or equivalent).
  • Proven success in delivering excellent customer service.
  • Ability to communicate complex accounting concepts clearly to clients and colleagues.
  • Strong organizational skills, time management, and attention to detail.
  • Professional, polished, and engaging personality with an approachable teaching style.
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment;
    quick learner and adaptable team player.


Why Join Us?

This role is ideal for accounting professionals who want to apply their technical expertise in a more dynamic, client-facing role. You’ll directly support vacation rental property managers by helping them master their accounting systems, stay in trust, and operate with confidence. At the same time, you’ll build skills in training, client success, and process improvement while working in one of the fastest-growing segments of the hospitality industry.

title: Sr. Program Manager Office
description:
Avenue Code is the leading software consultancy focused on delivering end-to-end development solutions for digital transformation across every vertical. We’re privately held, profitable, and have been on a solid growth trajectory since day one. We care deeply about our clients, our partners, and our people. We prefer the word ‘partner’ over ‘vendor’, and our investment in professional relationships is a reflection of that philosophy. We pride ourselves on our technical acumen, our collaborative problem-solving ability, and the warm professionalism of our teams.


About the Opportunity:

We are seeking a Program Manager on a contract basis. In this role, you will lead complex cross-functional programs that advance the PMO’s FY26 strategy for operational excellence. You will strengthen program management processes, introduce governance standards, and drive adoption of best practices across multiple teams.

Your impact will be measurable—helping streamline operations, reduce costs, improve efficiency, and enable smarter decision-making. The initial contract length is three months with a strong possibility of extension based on performance.

In this role, you will be expected to lead complex cross-functional programs that drive a range of capabilities, including supporting strategic planning, portfolio management and governance, and ad hoc initiatives for leadership. You will also play a key role in maturing program management processes, tools, and systems across teams.

Key to this role is the ability to gather and document business requirements for internal tools and systems and translate them into Technical Design Documents for submission to software development teams. You will also assist the tools and systems lead in the BPR PMO prioritize the product backlog of feature requests across multiple tools and systems. Central to your success will be the development and execution of a strong change management and communications strategy that enables smooth transitions and lasting impact.



Responsibilities:

  • Act as a business analyst to gather requirements across different functional teams, translate them into design documents and user journeys for submission to software development teams.
  • Create use case scenarios and end user journeys for multiple processes.
  • Create testing plans as well as tracking systems to ensure timely completion of testing.
  • Lead testing efforts and walk business user acceptance testers through the testing process.
  • Create end-user documentation and training materials.
  • Build business cases for prioritized projects and create leadership presentations to secure advocacy and resourcing.
  • Assess tools and systems used across functions;
    recommend consolidationand implement governance standards.
  • Define metrics and reporting to track progress and measure success;
    establish dashboards and scorecards.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional projects while demonstrating excellence in program and portfolio management.
  • Develop standardized templates, frameworks, and operating structures;
    drive adoption across teams.
  • Know where to drive standardization and where to allow for flexibility and creativity.
  • Deploy strong change management and communication strategies to ensure smooth transitions.
  • Facilitate meetings including driving the agenda and driving to closure on key decisions.
  • Take over PMO related tasks to run day-to-day operations and reporting.


Required Skills:

  • Solid experience managing and leading complex, cross-functional projects.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
  • Strong understanding of project, program, and portfolio planning with the ability to propose standards, set policies, and coach others.
  • Deep knowledge of end-to-end business processes within a high-tech manufacturing or operations environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive large-scale initiatives under pressure, complexity, and ambiguity.
  • Experience leading strategy and change across diverse, global teams.
  • Fluent English


Nice to Have Skills:

  • PMP (Project Management Professional) certification.
  • Certified ScrumMaster (CSM).
  • Knowledge of Six Sigma and DMAIC methodologies.
  • Familiarity with program and project management frameworks such as Agile, Kanban, Waterfall, and SDLC.
  • Prior consulting experience with Big 4 firms.
  • Experience in a large, global technology company.


Avenue Code reinforces its commitment to privacy and to all the principles guaranteed by the most accurate global data protection laws, such as GDPR, LGPD, CCPA and CPRA. The Candidate data shared with Avenue Code will be kept confidential and will not be transmitted to disinterested third parties, nor will it be used for purposes other than the application for open positions. As a Consultancy company, Avenue Code may share your information with its clients and other Companies from the CompassUol Group to which Avenue Code’s consultants are allocated to perform its services.

title: Fund Manager
description:
Fund Operations Manager (AMIF)

Location: Sao Paulo, Brazil - On site

Company: Amicorp Fund Services


Are you an experienced fund professional ready to take the lead in managing complex fund structures, driving operational excellence, and fostering lasting client relationships? Join Amicorp Fund Services , a trusted global provider of fund administration and corporate services, and play a pivotal role in expanding our fund operations footprint.


About the Role

As Fund Operations Manager , you will ensure Amicorp meets all contractual, regulatory, and statutory obligations while actively supporting commercial growth. You’ll oversee the setup and administration of multiple investment funds, manage a dedicated team, and act as a key liaison between clients, investors, and internal departments.

This role blends technical fund expertise , leadership , and a commercial mindset — ideal for someone passionate about both operations and strategic growth.


Key Responsibilities

Client & Deal Management

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of fund administration clients, fostering long-term, trust-based relationships.
  • Advise on optimal fund structures, legal and regulatory frameworks, and ongoing process improvements.
  • Oversee the drafting and review of commercial, fiscal, and legal documentation.
  • Support fund launches, restructures, and liquidations, ensuring seamless execution and compliance.
  • Attend client and internal meetings to provide technical and operational insights.

Sales & Business Growth

  • Contribute to the commercial growth of Amicorp Fund Services by identifying opportunities and closing deals aligned with business targets.
  • Develop and execute an ambitious sales plan, focusing on expanding relationships with existing clients and attracting new investors.
  • Oversee smooth onboarding and transition management for new clients, ensuring a best-in-class experience.

Operational Excellence & Compliance

  • Collaborate with global accounting teams (India/Mauritius) to deliver accurate and timely fund administration services.
  • Review NAV packages, financial statements, and investor reports to ensure accuracy.
  • Monitor KYC/AML checks, fund compliance, and audit readiness.
  • Maintain comprehensive client records and ensure adherence to all reporting and regulatory requirements.

Team Leadership

  • Lead and mentor the Fund Operations team, ensuring high performance, accountability, and professional growth.
  • Oversee training, performance management, and productivity tracking.
  • Promote standardized procedures, process optimization, and continuous improvement across operations.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree (minimum) with 15+ years of experience in the investment fund industry.
  • Strong professional network within family offices, investment advisers, foreign investors, and the venture capital community.
  • Proven experience managing teams and fund operations in a fast-paced environment.
  • Expertise in fund accounting, NAV calculations, capital calls, audit processes, and tax fund structures.
  • Strong understanding of IFRS / US GAAP and both UCITS and Alternative Investment Funds (AIFs) .
  • Excellent client-facing, communication, and leadership skills.
  • Commercially driven, proactive, and detail-oriented mindset.
  • Experience with PFX Paxus is an advantage.
  • CGA / CGE certification required.


Why Join Amicorp?

At Amicorp, we believe in empowering our people to lead with purpose, innovate fearlessly, and deliver excellence. You’ll work with a global network of experts, gain exposure to diverse jurisdictions, and be part of a company that values integrity, collaboration, and professional growth.

Join us to make a lasting impact in a dynamic and truly international fund services environment.

title: Learning Expert
description:
Job Summary : The Learning Expert is responsible for applying employee training programs, conducting training needs analysis, and developing engaging learning content. This role ensures smooth training logistics, maintains training records, and supports the continuous improvement of L&D initiatives.


Key Responsibilities:

1. Training Program Application

  • Schedule, organize, and deliver training programs through lectures, workshops, videos, e-learning, and blended formats.
  • Apply training logistics, including scheduling, venue bookings, facilitator coordination, and employee enrollment.
  • Maintain and update the Learning Management System (LMS) and training records.
  • Handle administrative duties such as tracking attendance, sending reminders, and managing training budgets.

2. New Employee Orientation Facilitation

  • Design, update, and facilitate engaging onboarding programs for new hires.
  • Collaborate with HR and department leaders to ensure a smooth transition for new employees.
  • Continuously improve trainings based on feedback and evolving company needs.

3. Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

  • Conduct surveys, interviews, and performance assessments to identify skill gaps.
  • Monitor and evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, quizzes, and KPIs (e.G., completion rates, performance improvement).
  • Adjust training programs based on data insights to enhance engagement and knowledge retention.

4. Content & Training Material Development

  • Create and update training manuals, guides, job aids, and digital resources for employee learning.
  • Develop interactive content (e-learning modules, videos, quizzes, presentations).
  • Ensure materials comply with company policies and industry standards.

5. Training Delivery & Facilitation

  • Conduct engaging live and virtual training sessions for employees at all levels.
  • Use diverse training methods (role-playing, simulations, discussions) to maximize learning.
  • Provide post-training support to reinforce key concepts.

6. Stakeholder Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Partner with department heads to align training with business goals.
  • Support ad-hoc Learning initiatives (leadership development, new employees training, etc.).
  • Promote a culture of continuous learning through newsletters, LMS updates, and recognition programs.

7. Qualifications & Skills:

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in HR, Organizational Development, Education, or related field.
  • Experience: 7+ years in Learning, training application, or HR, including facilitation and content creation.
  • Language Proficiency: Fluent in English (written and spoken).

title: Iam Consultant Cybersecurity
description:
Korn Ferry has partnered with our client on their search for IAM Consultant Cybersecurity


The IAM Consultant Cybersecurity plays a critical role in strengthening an Asian financial institution in Brazil information security posture by ensuring that access to systems and data is granted appropriately, securely, and in full alignment with governance policies. This position exists to safeguard the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of information assets while enabling operational efficiency and regulatory compliance.


To expand its digital ecosystem, average of 300 modules and systems, where 20 systems with their modules will have SOD implemented through a risk matrix, the challenge lies in maintaining robust access controls across a complex and evolving environment. The IAM function is at the heart of this transformation, and this role is essential to bridge operational execution with strategic governance.


The professional in this role will be responsible not only for handling access requests but also for ensuring that each access is justified, traceable, and compliant with internal policies and external audit requirements. This includes working with tools like CyberArk , Varonis , and ServiceNow , while also supporting SoD validations and recertification processes.


The broader challenge for the Information Security team is to shift from a reactive access management model to a proactive, governance-driven approach, where risks are anticipated, processes are standardized, and security is embedded into every access decision. This position is key to driving that shift, bringing technical expertise, process discipline, and a strong sense of ownership to the IAM domain.


Main Challenges and Assignments

  • Be responsible for activities related to Identity, Privileged and Access management, and Segregation Duties through hands-on execution .
  • Lead and execute Privileged Access Management (PAM) operations, with deep hands-on expertise in CyberArk , focusing on vault organization, password rotation, and privileged account governance.
  • Speed in Access Management Response, shifting from a reactive to a proactive stance, following audit findings, continuous monitoring capabilities, and rapid implementation of corrective measures.
  • Support access governance across 300+ systems and modules, ensuring alignment with RBAC and SoD principles , and collaborating with global teams on SoD validation.
  • Operate in a manual and evolving environment , bringing structure, routines, and logic to PAM processes without relying solely on tool implementation and IAM through ServiceNow.
  • Handling urgent requests and stakeholder pressure , while maintaining a firm, technically sound stance.
  • Act as a technical executor , not just a strategist, someone who can “get hands dirty” while applying best practices and security logic in daily operations.
  • Supporting the design of new access flows to ensure traceability and compliance from the outset.
  • Navigating a multicultural environment, with frequent interactions and meetings in English with global teams.


Experience and Professional Qualifications

  • Deep understanding of IAM, PAM, SoD, Access Investigation, ITSM and Security/Access Third-Parties companies.
  • Proven experience in PAM administration (CyberArk) , including vault configuration, password rotation policies, account onboarding, and alert handling, beyond tool usage: able to design and implement governance routines and access control logic.
  • Used to work with policies, norms, and procedures that comply with local and regional regulations, such as ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD.
  • Solid knowledge of IAM fundamentals , including RBAC, SoD, access lifecycle, and recertification processes.
  • Experience with log analysis, alert configuration, access investigation (Varonis) , and ServiceNow to access request workflows, incident registration, and audit traceability.
  • Familiarity with security frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, and LGPD, and ability to apply them in operational and audit contexts.
  • Knowledge of Bank Processes, regulations, and ensuring compliance with these requirements (Differential).
  • Bachelor's degree or higher in an engineering field (e.G., Computer Engineering, Technology, etc.).
  • Advanced Conversational English, to absorb global directives and participate in international meetings.


Behaviors Skills

  • Security Ownership & Accountability – Takes full responsibility for privileged access operations, ensuring secure and compliant execution even beyond direct scope.
  • Proactive Risk Management – Anticipates vulnerabilities in access and credential management, acting before incidents occur.
  • Assertive Communication – Maintains a firm and respectful stance when challenging access requests, navigating conflicts with clarity and professionalism.
  • Operational Discipline & Technical Curiosity – Applies security logic in daily execution, questions configurations, and continuously seeks process improvements.

Habilidades esperadas:


  • Capacidade de comunicação e argumentação;
  • Organização, pois vai atuar com detalhamento e requisitos de processos;

No Daycoval, entendemos que cuidar de nossos colaboradores é essencial para promover um ambiente de trabalho saudável e produtivo. Por isso, oferecemos um pacote abrangente de benefícios, proporcionando não apenas estabilidade, mas também qualidade de vida. Nosso compromisso com o seu bem-estar vai além do profissionalismo, é uma extensão do respeito que temos por cada membro de nossa equipe.

  • Seguro de Vida
  • Auxílio Creche: Apoio financeiro para conciliar trabalho e responsabilidades familiares.
  • Apoio à Educação: Suporte para desenvolvimento acadêmico e profissional, investindo no seu desenvolvimento.
  • Parcerias com Desconto: Vantagens exclusivas em uma variedade de produtos e serviços por meio de parcerias estratégicas.

  • Totalpass - Incentivo à Saúde: Acesso a uma ampla rede de atividades físicas, promovendo um estilo de vida ativo e saudável.

title: Senior Social Media & Influencer Specialist
description:
Job Summary :

1、Develop and execute comprehensive social media strategies to increase brand awareness and engagement in the Brazilian market.

2、Manage and collaborate with a network of influencers, ensuring alignment with brand values and objectives, and fostering long-term partnerships.

3、Track, analyze, and report on social media performance metrics to optimize content and campaigns, and provide insights for decision-making.

4、Create and curate compelling content for various social media platforms, staying up-to-date with trends and best practices.

5、Coordinate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, PR, and creative departments, to ensure cohesive messaging and campaign integration.

6、Hiring influencers and embassadors to AliExperts program.

7、PM Development of AliExperts project growing the influencer base as well as impacted consumers.


Qualifications:

1、Master's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field.

2、Above 5 years of experience in social media management, with a proven track record in the Brazilian market.

3、Deep understanding of major social media platforms, algorithms, and best practices for content creation and distribution.

4、Strong networking skills and experience in managing influencer relationships, negotiating contracts, and measuring ROI.

5、Fluent in Portuguese and English, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

6、Proven ability to lead and manage projects, meet deadlines, and work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

7、Experience working in a global company or with cross-cultural teams is preferred.

8、Experience working in an ecommerce company is preferred.

9、Previous experience in developing brand campaigns will be a bonus

10、Fluent in English and English resume only!!!!

title: Head De Expansão B2b
description:
Head de Expansão B2B – "Rede de Franquias " (Mercado Financeiro)



Estamos em busca de um(a) profissional estratégico e altamente motivado para liderar a nossa frente de crescimento B2B. Essa posição será responsável pela expansão e gestão da rede de franquias, atuando diretamente na prospecção, negociação, integração e desenvolvimento contínuo dos franqueados.



Responsabilidades


Ser o responsável comercial pela expansão da rede de franquias, conduzindo todo o ciclo de captação de novos parceiros;

Negociar e fecharcontratos com interessados em fazer parte da rede;

Desenvolver, apoiar e acompanhar a performance dos franqueados, garantindo a padronização e qualidade das operações;

Representar a marca com excelência no mercado, fortalecendo relacionamentos estratégicos.



Requisitos


Experiência comprovada no mercado financeiro;

Certificação obrigatória: CPA20, CEA, CFP ou outras equivalentes;

Perfil fortementecomercial, com habilidade para atuar em ambiente competitivo e de alta performance;

Capacidade de liderança, gestão de rede e desenvolvimento de pessoas;

Forte orientação para resultados e visão estratégica de negócios.

O que oferecemos

Oportunidade de atuar em um projeto de expansão nacional de alto impacto;

Ambiente dinâmico, meritocrático e colaborativo;

Pacote competitivo de remuneração e benefícios;

Possibilidade real de crescimento e protagonismo dentro da organização, incluindo elegibilidade à sociedade através da nossa política de partnership.



Se você tem paixão pelo mercado financeiro, perfil comercial aguçado e deseja crescer em um projeto ambicioso, esta é a sua oportunidade.

title: Diarista
description: Ofereça seus serviços de faxina através da Tidmo. A Tidmo é uma plataforma online que conecta profissionais de limpeza com contratantes de faxinas. A empresa promete te ajudar a manter uma agenda cheia de faxinas, podendo faturar até R$ 2.500,00 por mês. Além disso, você pode escolher os horários que deseja trabalhar. Atenção, a vaga está disponível apenas para mulheres.

title: Entregador(a) com moto
description:
Seja um(a) entregador(a) parceiro(a) da DM Logística e faça entregas de mercadoria com a sua moto. Você deverá recolher as mercadorias no centro de distribuição e levar até o endereço do cliente final. Os roteiros de entrega são otimizados e incluem um grande número de entregas por dia, aumentando os seus ganhos. Você recebe de acordo com o número de entregas realizadas com sucesso.

Atenção, é preciso possuir moto própria e MEI ativo para se candidatar para esta vaga.

title: Diarista
description: Você trabalha como diarista fazendo faxinas em casas, apartamentos ou em empresas. Você escolhe os serviços que deseja pegar e as regiões onde deseja trabalhar. O valor das diárias varia com o número de horas necessárias para terminar a faxina. Segundo a Parafuzo você pode esperar um ganho médio mensal de até R$ 3 mil por mês.

title: Entregador(a) com moto
description:
Seja um(a) entregador(a) parceiro(a) da DM Logística e faça entregas de mercadoria com a sua moto. Você deverá recolher as mercadorias no centro de distribuição e levar até o endereço do cliente final. Atenção, é preciso possuir moto própria e MEI ativo para se candidatar para esta vaga.

Somos a Alice, o primeiro plano de saúde do Brasil com time de saúde. Acreditamos em um modelo de saúde inovador e colocamos o nosso membro no centro das decisões por meio da tecnologia, empatia, transparência e simplicidade. Ser reconhecido pela excelência no cuidado, na gestão e no ensino.

✓ Realizar notificações de eventos adversos e incidentes em saúde;
✓ Prestar suporte nas atividades da coordenação;
✓ Atuar como apoio às equipes assistenciais em situação de catástrofe/ pandemia;
✓ Observar os preceitos éticos no decorrer da execução de suas atividades;
✓ Atender a solicitação da instituição para atuar como Preceptor, Tutor, Docente e em atividades de ensino;
✓ Participar juntamente com a equipe multiprofissional, de programas de educação continuada em saúde, comissões permanentes, programas de vigilância em saúde, biossegurança, epidemiologia hospitalar e prevenção de acidentes;
✓ Apoiar as coordenações hospitalares em assuntos inerentes a sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo soluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas e auxiliar na busca pela melhoria contínua dos processos da área;

✓ Participar ou atuar como facilitador das ações de Educação Permanente, conforme política institucional, no âmbito de suas atividades;
✓ Zelar pelos materiais e equipamentos sob sua responsabilidade, utilizados na execução do trabalho, a fim de prolongar a vida útil destes;
✓ Executar o trabalho observando aspectos relativos à segurança no trabalho, utilizando adequadamente os EPI's em todas as atividades, cumprindo a legislação vigente e normas institucionais;
✓ Apoiar o superior imediato em assuntos inerentes a sua área de atuação, apresentando e discutindo soluções para problemas e irregularidades, a fim de subsidiar a definição de ações a serem adotadas e auxiliar na busca pela melhoria contínua dos processos da área;

description:
O Hospital de Câncer de Pernambuco (HCP) é uma instituição privada e sem fins lucrativos que presta serviços de saúde exclusivamente por meio do Sistema Único de Saúde – SUS. Com mais de 80 anos de atuação, dedica-se ao diagnóstico e tratamento de pacientes oncológicos em todo o estado de Pernambuco.

Aqui, valorizamos, incentivamos e acreditamos nas pessoas e em sua capacidade de realização, entrega e desenvolvimento.

Se você se identifica com um ambiente inovador que oferece desafios contínuos, venha fazer parte do nosso time.

COORDENADOR MÉDICO DO TRABALHO (RECIFE-PE)

Principais Atividades:

  1. Contribuir com a Missão, Visão e Valores da instituição, promovendo o entendimento e a prática desses princípios na rotina diária, valorizando a qualidade dos serviços, o respeito socioambiental, a empatia, o cuidado e a ética com pacientes e colaboradores;
  2. Garantir o cumprimento das normas de segurança, seguindo os critérios estabelecidos pela equipe de Segurança do Trabalho;
  3. Seguir os procedimentos operacionais do setor para garantir o bom desenvolvimento e a padronização das atividades de rotina;
  4. Elaborar, implementar e coordenar o PCMSO (Programa de Controle Médico de Saúde Ocupacional), conforme exigido pela NR-7;
  5. Auxiliar na realização de exames clínicos ocupacionais (admissionais, periódicos, de retorno ao trabalho, mudança de risco e demissionais);
  6. Emitir pareceres médicos sobre a aptidão laboral, restrições e afastamentos;
  7. Acompanhar e analisar indicadores de saúde ocupacional, como absenteísmo, atestados médicos e acidentes de trabalho;
  8. Supervisionar ocumprimento de protocolos médicos e a documentação legal em prontuários e sistema SOC;
  9. Colaborar com aCIPA, SESMT e outras áreas (RH, Jurídico, Segurança do Trabalho) em ações de prevenção à saúde;
  10. Participar de comitês internos relacionados à saúde e segurança;
  11. Coordenar campanhas internas de saúde, como vacinação, prevenção de doenças e saúde mental;
  12. Atuar em processos de reabilitação profissional, inclusão de PCDs e programas de retorno ao trabalho;
  13. Interface com oINSS, perícias médicas e acompanhamento de benefícios previdenciários, juntamente com a equipe de enfermagem do trabalho;
  14. Manter-se atualizado sobre legislações e normativas referentes à Medicina do Trabalho e implementá-las na instituição.

Delta Hospital (DH) is seeking qualified physicians to join our Hospitalist program in a permanent part-time/full-time or locum capacity. Applicants should have a strong interest in developing an acute care hospital practice and working collaboratively with all members of the inter-professional team, including Medical and Allied Health staff.

Experience at Delta Hospital is an asset, but not necessary.

The Hospitalist program at Delta Hospital provides 24-hr coverage, 10 hour daytime shifts, 8 hour evening admission shift and 9 hour rotating overnight call shifts. The average patient census is 58, with four hospitalists covering each day and one during the evening hours. The overnight call is a virtual line from home. You can do up to 20% of patient care from home with remote access.

Eligibility: Candidates must be licensed or (eligible for licensure) with College of Physicians and Surgeons of British Columbia (CPSBC) and have either CCFP (or equivalent) credentials. Certification in ACLS is preferred. Hospitalist experience is strongly suggested.

Compensation: per physician master agreement. Full-time work is 14 days per month, or 1680 hours per year. Part-time work is anticipated to be approximately 50% of those hours, with option for additional shifts. Locum coverage is anyone on a roster to pick up shifts.

Principal / Sr Principal – for Pharma HQ in Switzerland
IQVIA is The Human Data Science Company, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.
To help our clients navigate a wide range of challenges, we are looking for talented, senior leaders to join our team of entrepreneurial problem-solvers in Switzerland.
We are a global team working with leading life science organisations and innovative biotechs to diagnose critical business issues, co-create evidence-based solutions and realise tangible impact in our clients’ organisations, for the benefit of patients.
We are a team of strategic thinkers, ensuring our client is at the centre of what we do, bringing together the required expertise from across IQVIA. We are successful because we are collaborative, curious, and disruptive.
Whether your background is more in real world evidence, market access, medical affairs, commercial strategy, or data analytics, we are interested in all team players who have a relentless client-first mindset and problem-solving skillset.
Why Join?

  • Become part of a recognized global leader in life science services and solutions, still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care.
  • Closely partner with leading companies to answer the toughest industry problems with the largest data sets, best-in-class experts and cutting-edge technology.

Work in a flexible hybrid model that combines in-office and at-client days, as well as permitting working from home.
The Role
As a Principal / Sr Principal within our team, you will take on a variety of roles within the following core areas: business development, client relationship building, project leadership, team development.
The role requires an inquisitive, consulting mindset to develop new opportunities, alongside a customer-first mentality to grow long-term partnerships with headquarters clients. Working closely with other go-to-market team members, you will engage with a diverse mix of client stakeholders to identify their needs and develop custom solutions across the life sciences value chain.
Responsibilities
  • Build client intimacy with key stakeholders at key accounts to drive business development opportunities within specific practice areas as well as for the broader IQVIA business.

    ultimate responsibilityfor delivering high quality/added value in e.Very project and client satisfaction.
  • Allocate direction, advice, and intellectual leadership to clients and delivery teams.

  • Provide follow-up with clients after project deliverables have been completed to ensure client satisfaction and continued engagement.
  • Lead thought leadership and firm building initiatives and contribute to the enhanced awareness of IQVIA consulting services in the marketplace, e.G. through speaking engagements, client meetings, and publications.
  • Mentor, coach, and share feedback and subject matter expertise with others to help develop individuals and capabilities delivering world-class solutions for clients.
  • Participate in annual performance review team processes as requried.
  • Engage in recruitment and selection of new staff.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Significant part of previous experience gained in selling / BD roles within consulting / professional services in Life Science.
  • Expertise in various of the following domains: real-world evidence, medical affairs, HEOR, market access, commercial strategy and operations, data science and analytics.
  • Strong interest and experience in developing and delivering innovative solutions across the product lifecycle.

  • Commercial awareness, including experience in balancing scope management and client relationship to ensure commercial objectives are met.

  • Offerings’ development experience – familiarity with accepted innovations models e.G., open innovation, ideation, product platforming, immersion or similar would be beneficial.

  • Excellent interpersonal and networking skills. Values people’s opinions and encourages knowledge sharing.
  • Previous experience in coaching junior team-members, ideally in a formal coaching role.
  • Leadership experience in complex organizations with demonstrated results in aligning people without formal reporting relationships.
Your Behaviours
Regardless of your background or your functional expertise, we are on the lookout for experienced team members who will live the below behaviours on a daily basis:
  • Client centricity
  • Delivery excellence

title: Director Of Nursing Don
description:
The Clinical Nurse Supervisor / DON requires meeting high standards in the area of supervising the nursing department. Provides direction, coordination, and implantation of professional and supportive services to residents in the provision of healthcare.

Responsibilities
  • Assumes responsibility for overseeing the total nursing care of all residents.
  • Ensures/monitors the accuracy of nursing care records.
  • Establishes/implements procedures for the provision of nursing care and the delegated medical care.
  • Ensures the development of nursing care policy and procedure manuals, and the availability of the manuals for all staff.
  • Implements systems to assure compliance with all state and federal local guidelines.
  • Participates with Educational Services in the planning of orientation programs for new nursing personnel, volunteers, temporary staff, and continuing in-service education for all nursing staff.
  • Introduces health services to new clients and families.
  • Determines, with the Executive team, the numbers and levels of nursing personnel to be employed.
  • Participates in the recruitment, selection and termination of nursing personnel.
  • Participates in the selection of prospective residents based on nursing care needs, and nursing personnel competencies available.
  • Creates effective working relationships amongst all staff, acting as liaison between nursing and other dept.
  • Develops positive working relationships with medical director, doctors, and community.
  • Participates in planning, decision making and budgeting for nursing care.
  • Ensures nursing department stays within budget while maintaining high quality resident care.
  • Ensures staff and family concerns are effectively resolved.
  • Coordinates and directs staff and facility meetings.
  • Establishes working relationship with Hospice vendor to assure residents needs are met.
  • Develops long-range plans for the nursing department, in conjunction with the Executive team, based on social, economic, political and technological changes.
  • Cooperates in developing and implementing an interdisciplinary approach to health care services.
  • Assumes responsibility from the Executive Director as assigned.
Resident Care
  • Monitors residents to ensure optimum care.
  • Answers resident call lights when needed.
  • Participates in admission and discharge process as needed;
    assures all necessary nursing admission papers and requirements are completed.
  • Maintains contact with physicians regarding residents’ care needs.
  • Assures that a comprehensive plan of care is established and implemented for each resident, and that the plan of care is reviewed at least quarterly and within seven (7) days of the revision of the comprehensive assessment.
  • Assures order and cleanliness of nursing units.
  • Assists with resident care as time allows oral feeding, treatments, medication, one-to-one time and wound care.
  • Is a part of facility Safety and Quality assurance meetings.
  • Ensures coordination of nursing services for the residents with other resident care services provided both within and outside of Assisted Living.
  • Interacts with physicians to plan of care for residents.
  • Assures that discharge and transfer planning for residents is conducted.
  • Ensures resident rights are protected and standards of care are maintained.
  • Assures all documentation is monitored to ensure compliance with standards.
  • Ensures care plans are updated.
  • Reviews all incident reports.
  • Prepares for doctor's rounds.
  • Assists doctor during his/her rounds.
  • Completes discharge summaries.
Supervision
  • Ensure staff development with training and orientation programs to ensure competency of staff and to meet regulatory requirements.
  • Maintains and promotes a positive attitude.
  • Delegates responsibilities and follow-up so that work is done in an effective and efficient manner.
  • Supervises employees within the dept., which may include coaching employees, terminating employees.
  • Delegates and monitors non-nursing responsibilities to other staff consistent with their training, experience, competence and legal authorization and within policy guidelines.
  • Assigns, supervises and evaluates the performance of all nursing personnel.
  • Ensures that evaluations occur for each nursing employee at least annually.
Safety/Compliance
  • Accepts and follows through with all policies and procedures.
  • Identifies and corrects hazards and unsafe acts and reports all quality issues.
  • Is aware of and adheres to all HIPAA regulations.
  • Adheres to policies on infection control, safety and resident rights.
  • Completes all Educare and other training required.
  • Participates in facility QAPI, Quality Assurance Performance Improvement program and activities.
Knowledge And Skills
  • Able to communicate effectively with relatives of residents and promotes a homelike atmosphere on the unit.
  • Able to work with other departments in furthering the team concept of Long-Term Care and the Customer Service Initiatives.
  • Able to demonstrate an ability to assess the physical, emotional, spiritual, and psycho-social status of the residents and to plan and implement nursing care.
  • Able to maintain confidential information.
  • Ability to prioritize tasks.
  • Ability to focus all efforts on quality resident care.
  • Awareness of all moral and legal implications of the Patient’s and Residents’ Bill of Rights and Vulnerable Adult Act.
  • Basic computer hardware and software knowledge to include basic Word and Excel.
  • Current knowledge of state and federal regulations.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Skills in problem definition and resolution.
  • Working knowledge of all applicable reimbursement systems
Required Experience And Education
  • Currently registered and licensed as an RN for at least 3-5 years.
  • Current CPR certification.
  • Previous experience in Nursing Administration and Supervision
  • Experience in Assisted Living facility.

About Us: Okalee of Medina is a senior living community providing independent living, assisted living, care suites and memory care options allowing our residents the ability to age in place. An amenity-rich, wellness-focused lifestyle community for older adults, Okalee of Medina is located in a serene, natural setting, yet with easy access to Highway 55.

A Bemol foi fundada em 13 de agosto de 1942 pelos irmãos Samuel, Israel e Saul Benchimol. Nos primeiros anos, atuou no comércio de medicamentos, passando posteriormente para cereais, cimento e, por fim, eletrodomésticos, ramo em que atuamos até os dias de hoje. Em 2016, a Bemol expandiu sua atuação na área da saúde com a inauguração da Bemol Farma , que atualmente possui 47 unidades físicas e 1 loja online. Para complementar essa frente, também contamos com uma unidade da Clínica Bemol Saúde .

description:
Overview

Senior Managing Consultant, Advisors Client Services, Strategy & Transformation

ADVISORS & CONSULTING SERVICES
Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.

The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Strategy & Transformation consultants lead clients through impactful decision-making as they tackle strategic, tactical, operational, and transformational business challenges. They apply a broad set of problem-solving techniques to improve the client’s overall strategy, performance, and operations.

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respects their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

Corporate Security Responsibility

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
